subject: AI & Data Science Graduate - Abhishek Bhosale
body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to you as Abhishek Bhosale, an AI & Data Science graduate, to convey my strong interest in exploring prospective roles within your organization. I am particularly eager to leverage my machine learning and data engineering capabilities in a dynamic environment like yours.

My professional background includes practical experience in the development and deployment of machine learning applications, the refinement of predictive models, and the construction of robust backend data systems. Specifically, my technical proficiencies cover MLOps pipelines utilizing Docker and MLflow, API development with FastAPI, and comprehensive SQL database management.

I would appreciate the chance to elaborate on how my specialized technical skills can benefit your team's objectives. For your consideration, my resume is enclosed.

Sincerely,
Abhishek Bhosale
Links: GitHub: https://github.com/just000Curious | Portfolio: https://abhishek-bhosale.vercel.app/ | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/abhishek-sambhaji-bhosale/
